cards.card_text: Their fathers, the LORD says, did not listen or incline their ear.
cards.verse_text: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.

cards.card_text: And still they would not listen to Him or incline their ear.
cards.verse_text: Yet they would not listen to Me or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers.
